original_target.title: Infinitely many obstacle resonances in a fixed strip under trapping
original_target.area: Scattering theory and numerical wave propagation

scope_comparison: The target is every smooth trapping obstacle in R3. The new author final-layout theorem assumes finitely many strictly convex real-analytic noneclipsing obstacles. The other theorem adds dynamical/frequency separation and coefficient-tail conditions not automatic for arbitrary trapping geometry. Resonance sign conventions have been accounted for.
